title: Taint parent containers for unresolvable YAML constructs instead of returning partial data
context: The Kubernetes manifest extractor was silently mishandling various YAML forms (block-scalar headers, nested maps, bare list markers, __proto__ keys), either dropping data or misinterpreting it, causing false reference edges between unrelated resources.
decision: When YAML constructs prevent reliable extraction—block-scalar headers, nested maps under labels, __proto__ keys, or bare list markers with deferred content—mark the entire parent container as unresolved (add to unresolvedContainers set) and return null for computed maps, rather than returning partial/corrupted data.
consequences: Resources with ambiguous names or selectors produce no false reference edges
Invalid Kubernetes (nested maps in selectors) is properly rejected instead of silently mishandled
The reference graph is incomplete but correct (no false positives)
__proto__ assignment blast radius is contained by using Object.fromEntries instead of direct assignment
alternatives_rejected: Silently drop unresolvable entries (makes map 'more permissive', matches things it shouldn't)
Return partial maps with only-understood entries (introduces false matches when data is incomplete)
Use direct object assignment `map[key] = value` (vulnerable to __proto__ attacks, sets prototype instead of own property)
Use ordinary pop logic for bare list markers (loses sequence frame, reparents children one level up)
